Reels Filming and Editing

We plan and film a batch of Reels, then deliver vertical videos ready to publish. Pricing depends on the number of videos and production scope.

What is included

  • Ideas and short scripts by agreement
  • A shoot for the agreed video count
  • Vertical edits, captions and publish-ready files

Suitable for

  • Brands and retailers
  • Doctors and experts
  • Restaurants and local services
  • Personal creators
